subject: Civil Engineering Draftsperson application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Western Grammar School team,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, checking work against them and keeping site and progress records.

Your role mixes drafting with coordinating contractors, consultants and council on the school's building program, and that mix of office and site is what I want. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. My CAD work so far is from study rather than commercial drafting, so I would start at junior level. I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

subject: Civil Engineering Assistant application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Ace Reo team,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Assistant role in Dandenong South that I saw on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I prepared quantities, bills of quantities and cost estimates and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, checking work against drawings, tracking materials and writing progress reports.

Your role covers take-offs, checking reinforcement against drawings and keeping QA records, which is the work I want to grow in. I'm based in Melton VIC with a licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I have about a year of site experience rather than the two to three years you list, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
